column1: Jeremy Pena leads off for Houston and brings a strong track record of consistency, recording a hit in over 75% of his games this season. Facing George Kirby at home, Pena’s reliable approach and steady contact rate make him a top pick for Beat The Streak. Yordan Alvarez, hitting right behind Pena, also offers a high hit probability and benefits from the platoon advantage. Jake McCarthy and Jacob Wilson are viable alternatives, but Pena’s combination of role and reliability stands out.
